name: torrent-worker
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg aria2 tmux && pip install -r requirements.txt
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'command -v tmux >/dev/null || sudo apt-get install -y tmux; tmux has-session -t w 2>/dev/null || tmux new-session -d -s w "python3 /workspaces/torrent-worker/worker.py --port 8080 2>&1 | tee /tmp/worker.log"'
